inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if digital-finance activity remains immaterial to normalized earnings, regulatory or custody costs offset revenue, take rates compress structurally, or adoption remains speculative and fails to support durable recurring economics.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Wider regulated digital-finance adoption can transmit into Robinhood through customer activity and monetization across cryptocurrency, custody, brokerage, transaction, subscription, and adjacent financial-product distribution.

objective: Review whether Robinhood has a material causal relationship to digital finance and crypto rails through cryptocurrency, custody, brokerage, transaction, subscription, and adjacent financial-product distribution; accept or reject the edge.
